updates.t: CGL 2026: Tier-I ran 30 Sep to 30 Oct 2026. Result expected in November. Tier-II not yet scheduled; expected Dec 2026 or Jan 2027.
CGL 2027: notification, application dates and exam date not yet announced. Two computer-based tiers expected.
CGL 2026 notice released: Tier-I now has a strict 15-minute timer per section; Tier-II Paper-III (Finance & Economics) introduced for AAO/AAcO; application window 21 May to 22 Jun 2026.
updates.src: Indian Govt News (quotes the official notice)

updates.t: Tier-II Paper-I marking: +3 per right answer, -1 per wrong. Merit total 390 marks (Maths + Reasoning + English + GA). Computer test is qualifying.
